apple.description:
Early Letters is the baby memory book you fill by talking.

Say a few words to your child at the end of the day. A first laugh, a long night, a song you made up in the car. Early Letters keeps it as a letter, in your words and in your voice, and files it by your child's month of age. Over time it becomes a book your child can read, and hear, for years.

EVERY CHANGE SHOWN
Your words are written down on your phone. We only fix small slips, like an um, a repeat or a misheard word, and mark each one. You can put any fix back with one tap, and we never rewrite your words.

YOUR VOICE, KEPT
The original recording stays with each letter, on your phone and in your iPhone's own backup if you use one. Years from now, your child can hear how you sounded when you said it. We never imitate your voice. Your original recording is always kept exactly as you made it.

READ TOGETHER
Open the book at bedtime and hear the letters you spoke, in your own voice, with the words on the page.

A SENTENCE IS PLENTY
Some days you have a sentence, some days a long letter. If today was quiet, tap "Not much today" and that is enough. Nothing keeps score. Write when you have something to say.

IN ENGLISH
This version works in English. The English speech model is a one-time download that you choose at the end of setup, so the app stays small.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your letters and recordings are private. We never sell them, never use them for ads and never use them to train machine learning models. Your book stays on your phone. You can export everything or delete everything, any time, from Settings.

A BOOK FOR EACH CHILD
Each child gets their own book, with their own months. Starting a book is free, and your first two letters are free across every book.

TAKE IT WITH YOU
Export your memory book any time, for free: your letters, your recordings and a PDF of the book.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Tap and talk, or type if you prefer.
2. Read it back. Fix a word if one is wrong.
3. It goes into this month of your child's book.

Early Letters is for parents of babies and young children, from the first weeks to the first years. Written early. Read again and again.

Your first two letters are free. Every letter you keep stays yours to read, play and export, with or without Plus. Plus is an optional subscription that lets you keep adding letters. It renews automatically until you cancel, and works with Family Sharing.

Terms of Service: https://earlyletters.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://earlyletters.com/privacy

googlePlay.fullDescription:
Early Letters is the baby memory book you fill by talking.

Say a few words to your child at the end of the day. A first laugh, a long night, a song you made up in the car. Early Letters keeps it as a letter, in your words and in your voice, and files it by month of age. Over time it becomes a book your child can read, and hear, for years.

IT STAYS IN YOUR WORDS
Your speech is written down on your phone. Early Letters fixes only small slips: an um, an accidental repeat, a name spelled the way you spell it, a capital letter, a full stop. It never adds a word. Every change is marked, and you can put any of them back. A microphone can mishear, so read each letter before you keep it. Letters you type stay exactly as you typed them.

YOUR VOICE, KEPT
Each letter you speak keeps its original recording, unchanged. It stays on your phone. Years from now, your child can hear how you sounded when you said it.

READ TOGETHER
Open the book at bedtime and hear the letters you spoke, in your own voice, with the words on the page.

A SENTENCE IS PLENTY
Some days you have a sentence, some days a long letter. If today was quiet, tap "Not much today" and that is enough. There are no counters, no badges and no scores.

IN ENGLISH
Early Letters works in English.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your letters and recordings are private. We never sell them, never use them for ads and never use them to train machine learning models. Your book stays on your phone. Delete a letter and it waits 30 days in Recently deleted, or you can erase it at once.

A BOOK FOR EACH CHILD
Each child gets their own book, with their own months. Starting a book is free, and your first two letters are free across every book.

TAKE IT WITH YOU
Export your memory book any time: your letters, your recordings and a PDF of the book. Every letter you have made stays yours to read, play and export, even if you stop.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Tap and talk, or type if you prefer.
2. Read it back. Fix a word if one is wrong.
3. It is saved to this month in your child's memory book.

Early Letters is for parents of babies and young children, from the first weeks to the first years. Written early. Read again and again.

PRICING
Your first two letters are free, so you can try it. To keep adding letters, choose Plus: $4.99 a month with a 1-month free trial, or $49.99 a year with a 2-month free trial. One membership covers every child's book. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel. Manage or cancel any time in the Subscriptions section of Google Play.

Privacy Policy: https://earlyletters.com/privacy
Terms: https://earlyletters.com/terms
